title: Glowing bicycle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'>
    <!-- rear wheel -->
    <circle cx='27' cy='68' r='17' stroke='#4FD8FF' stroke-width='3'/>
    <circle cx='27' cy='68' r='17' stroke='#9CF06A' stroke-width='1' stroke-dasharray='2 3'/>
    <circle cx='27' cy='68' r='3' stroke='#FFD84D' stroke-width='3'/>
    <!-- front wheel -->
    <circle cx='73' cy='68' r='17' stroke='#4FD8FF' stroke-width='3'/>
    <circle cx='73' cy='68' r='17' stroke='#9CF06A' stroke-width='1' stroke-dasharray='2 3'/>
    <circle cx='73' cy='68' r='3' stroke='#FFD84D' stroke-width='3'/>
    <!-- spokes rear -->
    <g stroke='#8AB4E8' stroke-width='1.2'>
      <line x1='27' y1='51' x2='27' y2='85'/>
      <line x1='10' y1='68' x2='44' y2='68'/>
      <line x1='15' y1='56' x2='39' y2='80'/>
      <line x1='39' y1='56' x2='15' y2='80'/>
    </g>
    <!-- spokes front -->
    <g stroke='#8AB4E8' stroke-width='1.2'>
      <line x1='73' y1='51' x2='73' y2='85'/>
      <line x1='56' y1='68' x2='90' y2='68'/>
      <line x1='61' y1='56' x2='85' y2='80'/>
      <line x1='85' y1='56' x2='61' y2='80'/>
    </g>
    <!-- frame -->
    <g stroke='#FF6FA8' stroke-width='4'>
      <line x1='27' y1='68' x2='50' y2='68'/>
      <line x1='50' y1='68' x2='38' y2='44'/>
      <line x1='38' y1='44' x2='27' y2='68'/>
      <line x1='50' y1='68' x2='68' y2='42'/>
      <line x1='38' y1='44' x2='68' y2='42'/>
    </g>
    <!-- seat -->
    <line x1='38' y1='44' x2='36' y2='36' stroke='#C88AFF' stroke-width='3'/>
    <path d='M30 36 Q36 30 43 36' stroke='#FFD84D' stroke-width='4' fill='none'/>
    <!-- handlebars -->
    <line x1='68' y1='42' x2='72' y2='30' stroke='#C88AFF' stroke-width='3'/>
    <path d='M64 28 Q72 24 80 30' stroke='#FFD84D' stroke-width='4' fill='none'/>
    <!-- fork -->
    <line x1='73' y1='68' x2='68' y2='42' stroke='#FF6FA8' stroke-width='3'/>
    <!-- pedals -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='68' r='5' stroke='#FFD84D' stroke-width='2'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='63' x2='54' y2='60' stroke='#9CF06A' stroke-width='2'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='73' x2='46' y2='76' stroke='#9CF06A' stroke-width='2'/>
  </g>
</svg>
